description: Matched-pair OR (unhelmeted vs helmeted, two-rider motorcycles with one death) under two-sided misreporting of helmet use with closed-form tipping fractions; n10 + n01 is the number of informative (helmet- and outcome-discordant) pairs
population: FARS 2016-2024 motorcycles with exactly 2 riders with known helmet use and exactly one death
method: As belt_misreporting_two_sided_matched_pair, applied to motorcycle riders
